crossRefs.note: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous…

However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing…

They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

translations.web: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
translations.bsb: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written: “The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.”
translations.kjv: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
translations.asv: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
